body: The converter compared native ZIP-relative chapter names to package-relative manifest hrefs, then searched the archive independently for the DOM. Nested OPF directories and escaped filenames could fail valid anchors or select a different same-named chapter. The fix resolves manifest URIs at the OPF boundary, chooses one unambiguous canonical member, and reads that same member. The classic reader now uses complete-spine chapter identity for overlays and navigation. Its actual sidebar now registers its missing panel controller, refuses stale-CFI fallback for unresolved native anchors, and resolves the live span after loading a chapter so the first click reaches the passage. Real browser tests require the target highlight in the viewport, create a selection, and switch tabs normally. Tests demonstrate pre-fix failures, exact selected-text round trips, duplicate-name refusal, escaped-name boundaries, and selection creation. Fixed in the candidate for #2208; public release remains pending.

resolution.note: Implemented and independently verified in the #2208 candidate; not yet released.

title: Native Kobo highlights can resolve a spine index and DOM from different chapter paths
